name: CreatePolarFs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域ID详情。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The storage type. For the high_performance edition, use lowercase essdpl0 or essdpl1. For the cold edition, use local_redundancy or city_redundancy. Select the value based on the edition. The value is case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh: 存储类型。high_performance 使用小写 essdpl0 或 essdpl1；cold 使用 local_redundancy 或 city_redundancy。请按所属产品系列选择，大小写敏感
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized accounts for the cold storage edition instance. Separate multiple accounts with commas (`,`)
parameters.help_zh: 冷存版实例授权账号列表，用`,`分隔
parameters.name: authorized_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The database ecosystem. Valid values: polardb_mysql (PolarDB for MySQL), polardb_pg (PolarDB for PostgreSQL), and polar_agentic_db (AgenticDB). The gateway maps these values to the mysql, postgresql, and agentic_db backends respectively. Pass the request value instead of the display name such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. If an ActionUnauthorized (HTTP 403) error is returned, check the call permissions
parameters.help_zh: 所属数据库生态。请求值可选 polardb_mysql（PolarDB MySQL）、polardb_pg（PolarDB PostgreSQL）或 polar_agentic_db（AgenticDB）。网关分别映射为后端 mysql、postgresql、agentic_db；请传请求值，不要传 MySQL 或 PostgreSQL 展示名称。若返回 ActionUnauthorized（HTTP 403），需检查调用权限
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区id
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The storage space. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 存储空间，单位 GB
parameters.name: storage_space

parameters.help_en: The PolarDB cluster ID. This parameter is required when you call this operation. If this parameter is not specified, the InvalidDBClusterId.Malformed error is returned
parameters.help_zh: PolarDB 集群 ID。调用本接口时必须提供；缺失会返回 InvalidDBClusterId.Malformed
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
If the billing method is Prepaid, this is a required pass parameter. Specifies whether the subscription cluster is billed by year or by month. 

Year: year. If you select subscription, the unit is year.
Month: month. If you select subscription, the unit is month
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

Year：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
Month：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required when the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid.
If the Period parameter is set to Month, the value of UsedTime must be an integer in the range of `[1-9]`.
If the Period parameter is set to Year, the value of UsedTime must be an integer in the range of `[1-3]`
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。
当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false.

This parameter takes effect only when the PayType parameter is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，取值范围如下：

true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

默认为false。

当参数PayType取值为Prepaid时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration startup mode. Valid values:

ONLY: enables acceleration only.
ON: enables cold data and acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
加速启动，取值范围如下：

ONLY：仅开启加速。
ON：开启冷叔据+加速
parameters.name: accelerate_switch

parameters.help_en: The acceleration space size. Unit: GB. The value must be no less than 5000 and must be a multiple of 1000. This parameter is required when acceleration is enabled for the basic edition
parameters.help_zh: 加速空间大小，单位为 GB。取值不小于 5000，且必须为 1000 的整数倍；basic 类型开启加速时需提供
parameters.name: accelerate_storage_size

parameters.help_en: The edition. Valid values: basic (Basic Edition, default), high_performance (High-performance Edition), and cold (Cold Storage Edition). For the basic edition, you must specify the AccelerateSwitch and AccelerateStorageSize parameters. For the high_performance edition, you must specify the StorageType parameter (essdpl0 or essdpl1). For the cold edition, the StorageType parameter (local_redundancy or city_redundancy) is optional
parameters.help_zh: 产品系列：basic（基础版，默认）、high_performance（高性能版）或 cold（冷存版）。basic 类型需指定 AccelerateSwitch 和 AccelerateStorageSize；high_performance 类型需指定 StorageType（essdpl0 或 essdpl1）；cold 类型可选 StorageType（local_redundancy 或 city_redundancy）
parameters.name: creation_category

parameters.help_en:
The number of buckets.

This parameter is required only when acceleration (file system acceleration) is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket 数量。

仅开启加速（文件系统加速）场景必填
parameters.name: custom_bucket_count

parameters.help_en:
The bucket path.

This parameter is required only when acceleration (file system acceleration) is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
bucket路径。

仅开启加速（文件系统加速）场景必填
parameters.name: custom_bucket_path

parameters.help_en: The custom AccessKey ID
parameters.help_zh: 自定义ak
parameters.name: custom_oss_ak

parameters.help_en: The custom AccessKey secret
parameters.help_zh: 自定义sk
parameters.name: custom_oss_sk

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true: uses coupons (default).
false: does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值范围如下：
true：使用优惠券（默认值）。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If this parameter is not specified, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration type. Valid values: 

juice: file system acceleration.
alluxio: transparent acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
加速类型，取值为范围如下： 

juice：文件系统加速。
alluxio：透明加速
parameters.name: accelerate_type

parameters.help_en:
The bucket and corresponding path information.

This parameter is required for transparent acceleration scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket及对应路径信息。

透明加速场景必填
parameters.name: custom_bucket_path_list

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
